question.text: Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, what is the minimum net tangible asset requirement for an issuer seeking eligibility for an IPO under Regulation 6(1)?

answer.text: Rs. 1 crore in each of the 3 preceding full years
Rs. 5 crore in each of the 3 preceding full years
Rs. 3 crore in each of the 3 preceding full years
Rs. 10 crore in each of the 3 preceding full years

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 6(1) of SEBI ICDR Regulations requires net tangible assets of at least Rs. 3 crore in each of the three preceding full years, with not more than 50% held in monetary assets (unless utilized or committed). The Trap: Rs. 1 crore is the minimum net worth requirement under Regulation 6(1), not the net tangible assets threshold. Rs. 5 crore and Rs. 10 crore are not prescribed figures for any of the Regulation 6(1) parameters.
